task.title: Add a New Device to Duo
task.shortdesc: Instructions for registering additional phones, tablets, security keys, and any of your other devices for use with Duo authentication.

context.p: Device registration steps in Duo are identical for students, faculty, and staff. Use this procedure to enroll an additional device—including a phone with a new phone number, a tablet, or a security key—on a computer.

step.cmd: Visit the Duo Device Management page on a computer and sign in with your Unity ID and password.
Sign in with Duo using a device already enrolled in Duo, by calling the NC State Help Desk at 919-515-4357 for a bypass code, or by visiting the OIT Walk-in Center.
Select the Add a device tile.
Select the type of device you are enrolling: choose Duo Mobile for a phone or tablet, or choose Security key for a hardware key.
Follow the on-screen instructions to finish enrolling your device.
